scope: Coverage baseline for user-requested IntelliSense-style technical completion
classification: Missing requested capability, not new correctness bug in current prefix-matching implementation.
finding: History matches whole-token prefix only; does not reuse email domain for another local part, offer scheme-less host, reuse path across scheme, or port across host.
design_requirements: Recognize technical kind and active component; preserve typed prefix and suffix.
Offer multiple selectable candidates; apply only explicit selection.
Distinguish complete previously observed address from newly composed suggestion; no claim destination/mailbox exists.
Never silently substitute scheme or port; suggestions only.
Preserve case semantics and technical punctuation, handle mid-token cursor and partial host context.
limits: Core recall only; no UI implementation.
Initial 192.168.1.10:8080 control was rejected by known maxDigits cap; replaced with 10.0.0.1:8080 to isolate component matching, then rerun.
